items.title: 修正 convergence_check 的终态 story 统计口径
items.context: DONE 与 DISCARDED 都是终态，convergence_check 的 activeStories 必须排除两者；保留 INIT/PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST 等真实未完成 story 的阻塞能力。
items.userSees: 运行 koala convergence_check 时，所有 Story 完成项不再把 DISCARDED story 列为未完成；如果未来存在 DEV/PLAN/TEST story，仍会正常阻塞。

happy.desc: 当前仓库只有 DONE/DISCARDED 终态时，convergence_check 的所有 Story 完成项通过或至少不列 DISCARDED 为未完成

edge.desc: 临时场景中包含 DISCARDED story 时，DISCARDED 被视为终态，不计入 activeStories

adversarial.desc: 临时场景中混入 DEV story 时，convergence_check 仍把 DEV 计入未完成，避免过度放行

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke covers terminal-only store and asserts Story completion passes when only DONE/DISCARDED stories exist on code HEAD a322332.
Smoke writes a DISCARDED story and asserts it is absent from active story failure detail on code HEAD a322332.
Smoke adds a DEV story after terminal stories and asserts completion check fails with B-dev only on code HEAD a322332.
